ns2:section.sectionText: Illinois Space Society (ISS) and Student Space Systems (SSS) are partnering to teach a introductory course in High Powered Rocketry and aerospace technical concepts. The course is designed for new students in aerospace and will provide hands-on experience with hardware and software used by the clubs and industry professionals. Students in the course will design a rocket, run tests and simulations of the structure and electronics, and launch the rocket at the conclusion of the course.
